theorem part3_sum_abs_primeAPError_log_saving (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ Q : ℕ, Q ≤ panModulusCutoff N B →
        ∀ S : Finset ℕ, S ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 Q →
          ∀ Y : ℕ, Y ≤ N → ∀ a : ℕ → ℕ,
            (∀ d ∈ S, Nat.Coprime (a d) d) →
            (∑ d ∈ S, |part3PrimeAPError Y (a d) d|) ≤
              C * (N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ) ^ A
